comments: 4d786884: This block initializes the Deficiency Tracking View screen.
14d8f729: Entry point for the View Deficiency option.
e3beb76f: Prepends spaces and a conditional asterisk to the 'Date Coded' label based on DGJTVIEW existence.
b29465cb: Reset X to an empty string for fresh assignment.
6a81d4cd: Position the 'Date Coded' label starting at column 42, spanning 21 characters.
323e192c: Format the coded date using the FileMan date format.
acf4ce83: Position the formatted date in the display line; then, update the temporary global storage.
d11f7f24: Exit point for the CODDT subroutine.
e9c9ea66: Prepends spaces and a conditional asterisk to the 'Coded By:' label based on DGJTVIEW existence.
a59222f8: Reset X to an empty string for fresh assignment.
ba38e5dc: Position the 'Coded By:' label starting at column 42, spanning 21 characters.
c77429c2: Retrieve the coder's name using their internal entry number (IEN) in the NEW PERSON file.
d19c99cb: Position the coder's name in the display line; then, update the temporary global storage.
9fe9ab95: Exit point for the CODBY subroutine.
439d5ef7: Extract the ICD diagnosis code from the patient movement and corresponding PTF record.
1e2483c2: Exit point for the helper subroutine 1.
ed93939f: This block handles the display of comments associated with a deficiency.
c938f4b8: Reset X to an empty string for fresh assignment.
e4acc40c: Add the item number prefix for the comments section.
a00d86b2: Reset X to an empty string for fresh assignment.
6f14c5ad: Add the 'Comments:' label as the header for the comments section.
6a38b8ef: Retrieve the first line of the comments from the deficiency record.
0f893da5: Display the first part of the comments up to 64 characters.
c04c3c28: Reset X to an empty string for fresh assignment.
52a90fd1: Display the next 64 characters of the comments, if any.
ed157361: Reset X to an empty string for fresh assignment.
32d161ab: Display the following 64 characters of the comments, if any.
f6159b80: Reset X to an empty string for fresh assignment.
356eda23: Display the remaining characters of the comments.
7f36f1e8: Exit point for the COM subroutine.
9c2affe0: This block determines the status of a deficiency based on various criteria.
01b13327: Set status to 'INCOMPLETE' if not signed or reviewed and specific flags are set.
28c41a9c: Set status to 'REVIEWED' if the deficiency has a review date.
7ae4891c: Set status to 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' if signed but not reviewed.
478a407c: Set status to 'SIGNED' if signed, regardless of review status.
fa5f6172: Catch-all for setting status to 'INCOMPLETE' if no other conditions are met.
e6d6bb86: Set status to 'DICTATED' if the deficiency is dictated but not transcribed.
5729faec: Set status to 'TRANSCRIBED' if the deficiency is transcribed but not signed.
b8a32b27: Set status to 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' if signed but not reviewed, without specific flags.
ed1cd8d5: Set status to 'SIGNED' if all requirements are met but not reviewed.
39656c88: Set status to 'REVIEWED' if reviewed, regardless of other conditions.
d47f47c3: Update the deficiency record with the new status.
0a2867c8: Exit point for the STAT1 subroutine.
